limits: The apply path is proven with a synthetic native fixture pair whose C-vs-A strata are assessed noninferior (OD-4); real SPEC-072 pairs are refused. Human identity, safety counts and the current identity are self-asserted by the caller.
outcome: passed: apply_promote recomputes the preview, requires its digest, then calls harness_promotion.decide() with a human actor (approved), records and begins the decision, saves the registry, replaces the mapped SKILL.md by same-directory temp file, fsync and rename, commits and saves; the journal reads recorded, begun, committed and the registry's active candidate equals the file digest. Writes are bounded to the scope's registry file, its lock file and the mapped SKILL.md. Negative controls: automatic actor (automatic-promotion-disabled), synthetic cohort (cohort-mismatch), drifted current identity (stale-model), unsafe or unknown safety counts (unsafe-admission, safety-unknown), a SPEC-072 descriptive-only pair (regression-not-covered, OD-4), re-applying the active candidate (already-active), no held-out support without an override reason (no-held-out-support); with a reason the decision carries the limit owner-override-no-held-out-support and the reason's SHA-256, never its text (OD-5). A failed file write or commit aborts: file bytes restored, journal ends aborted, no temp file left, no active profile.
